description: MID-RUN loop check (fast, no LLM, free). Send your recent steps DURING a run; get back whether you're stuck repeating a tool call and a concrete next move. Call this every few steps to catch a loop BEFORE you burn your step budget — don't wait for a postmortem. Non-blocking advice, not a verdict.

steps.description: your recent steps (last ~5-10), each with an action/tool and optionally inputs — same step shape as diagnose_trace

threshold.description: how many identical consecutive calls = a loop (default 3)

name: detect_loop

outputSchema.description: A JSON object (returned as text in result.content[0].text). Diagnosis tools return {matched, family, fix, confidence, source, action_class, auto_safe, gate}; other tools return their own JSON result.
